title: Golden Fool
author: Robin Hobb
review:
Very much a transitionary entry that wraps up some events in the first book and sets up the conflict for the final book in the trilogy.

Has some hard hitting moments, but definitely suffers from middle book syndrome. However, I've grown to trust Hobb to lay the foundation that will eventually pay off. This book is a lot of foundation building of things that are bound to be epic in the next book.

highlights.text: A burden shared not only can lighten it; it can form a bond between those who share it. So that no one is left to bear it alone.”
To recognize you are the source of your own loneliness is not a cure for it. But it is a step toward seeing that it is not inevitable, and that such a choice is not irrevocable.

“But change proves that you are still alive. Change often measures our tolerance for folk different from ourselves. Can we accept their languages, their customs, their garments, and their foods into our own lives? If we can, then we form bonds, bonds that make wars less likely. If we cannot, if we believe that we must do things as we have always done them, then we must either fight to remain as we are, or die.”
I wondered who I had been when I wrote them.
“That has been your greatest weakness, Fitz. All your life. Too much caution. Not enough ambition.
Perhaps the gods punish us by bringing us face to face with our own foolish mistakes, condemning us to watch our children fall into the same traps that crippled us.
“I look back, Fool, and sometimes it seems that the times when I was most certain I was doing the right thing was when I made my gravest errors.
I cannot tell if that change would aid me or hinder me in what I must do. I am, right now, more uncertain of my path than I have ever been.”
Strange, how being left out of a secret always feels like a betrayal of trust.
She walked on very thin ice, black water seeping up in her footprints.
For it is told that Icefyre will give such a man not only what he asks, but what he deserves, and that is not always good luck and gold.
Men. If it was raining soup, you’d be out there with a fork.”
You always chose to be bound by who you are. Now choose to be freed by who you are.

I’d have to teach him to be hungry if I was going to use bribery. At the same time, the simplicity of the things that this man longed for as unattainable cut to my heart. He wasn’t asking for better wages or more time to himself. Just the small things, the little pleasures that made a hard life tolerable.
“My lady queen, I loved Fitz, first as my friend’s son, and then as my friend. I loved him just as I love my own son now. And I will not lose another boy to that low magic. I will not.”

The foreignness of the being that had pressed against my mind disrupted me, gagging my thoughts as if I had tried to breathe oil or drink flame. Panting in the dark, I felt the sweat slide down my brow and back and wondered what my errant Skilling had awakened in the world.
All but the dullest students will swiftly realize that the body does not confine thoughts. They extend outside our flesh,

Ask the student, “Cannot you smell the wine that is opened across the room? Hear the shouts of sailors at work across the water? Then do not refuse to believe you can hear the thoughts of the man in the field that waft toward you.”

We’ve been careless of one another’s feelings, even as Chade and I are careless of one another. Because we trust that what we are and what we know from all the years are more important than words flung in anger.”
Keep watch, Nighteyes, I begged him, but there was no answer and no wolf stood over me.
One man armed with the right word may do what an army of swordsmen cannot.
Perhaps having the courage to find a better path is having the courage to risk making new mistakes.
